sourceChecks.note: Rolex's exact U.S. product page independently validates reference 126600, the current homogeneous Oystersteel/intense-black/Oyster configuration, USD 14,550 retail price, 43 mm diameter, calibre 3235, approximately 70 hours, -2/+2 seconds per day, 1,220 m water resistance, sapphire Cyclops crystal, Triplock screw-down crown, date, and Chromalight lasting up to eight hours. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

Bob's Watches states that its current-reference thickness, lug-to-lug, and weight table is measured in-house from inventory. Its 126600 row reports 15.0 mm thickness and 51.0 mm lug-to-lug. The approximate 195 g entry is not selected because a full-link control is available. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
The 2026 exact-reference control matrix documents a 194.0 g owner-verified, full-link, factory-unworn 126600 with Oyster bracelet and Glidelock. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
Everest's model-by-reference fitment guide lists references 126600 and 126603 with 22 mm lug width. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

Everest's exact fitment product identifies Sea-Dweller 43 references 126600 and 126603 and supplies Rolex-grade spring bars for the case connection, resolving the standard spring-bar interface. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
